references.label: Three-target drop bank
references.description: Upper bank whose repeated completions light outlane points, Bonus multipliers, and Extra Ball.

references.label: Single drop target
references.description: Route-finishing target used as an alternative to the three-target bank.

references.label: Left Route lane
references.description: Left-side lane that starts one Route.

references.label: Right Route lane
references.description: Right-side lane that starts the other Route.

references.label: Vari-target
references.description: Variable-value target that can reach 300,000 and lights Special on the last ball.

references.label: Eject hole
references.description: Hole whose second collect during a ball lights additional 50,000-point shots.
